# Unspecified output contract (LOG011)

No format, schema or length contract where a consumer expects one.

| Metadata | Value |
|---|---|
| Rule ID | `log-unspecified-output` |
| Family | logical |
| Applies to | `core` |
| Default severity | `warning` |
| Fix | `manual` |
| Evidence | prac |
| Sniffers | llm |
| Contextual evaluation | LLM |

No format, schema, or length given where downstream code will parse the output.

Bad:  Return the parsed users.
Good: Return a JSON array of {id, email} objects.

Not a finding when no consumer needs a fixed shape.
